traditionalDress.men: Kediyu or kurta with dhoti or churidar is common in traditional dress, especially during festivals.
traditionalDress.women: Chaniya choli or Gujarati saree drapes are prominent festive styles.

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.description: A nine-night celebration in which Garba and Dandiya Raas become major public cultural expressions across Gujarat.

festivals.name: Uttarayan
festivals.description: The January kite festival, celebrated with rooftop gatherings and distinctive Gujarati foods.

festivals.name: Janmashtami
festivals.description: A festival of Krishna celebrated in temples and communities across Gujarat, including Dwarka and the Saurashtra region.

folklore: Gujarati oral traditions include devotional bhajans, folk theatre such as Bhavai, community storytelling and songs tied to pastoral, agricultural and devotional life.
